gloss: grazing; pasturing; putting out to pasture

definitions.gloss: grazing; pasturing; putting livestock out to pasture
definitions.explanation: The practice of letting livestock roam and feed freely on open land.

examples.japanese: ⟦{牛|うし}→牛：01857_ushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放牧|ほうぼく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To put cattle out to pasture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{草原|そうげん}→草原：05035_sougen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{羊|ひつじ}→羊：04713_hitsuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{放牧|ほうぼく}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Sheep are grazing on the wide grassland.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{牧場|ぼくじょう}→牧場：06103_bokujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{放牧|ほうぼく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}てた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧⟦{牛|うし}→牛：01857_ushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乳|ちち}→乳：19347_chichi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦チーズ→チーズ：00026_chiizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: This ranch is known for cheese made from the milk of pasture-raised cattle.

notes:
Composed of {放|ほう} (release, let go) + {牧|ぼく} (herding, pasture). Describes the agricultural practice of free-range grazing as opposed to keeping animals in enclosed spaces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {放牧|ほうぼく}{地|ち} (pasture land, grazing land)
- {放牧|ほうぼく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧ (raise by free-range grazing)
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧{放牧|ほうぼく} (natural grazing)
- {放牧|ほうぼく}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (grazing period/season)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{牧畜|ぼくちく}→牧畜：20195_bokuchiku⟧ — livestock farming (the broader industry of raising animals)
- ⟦{飼育|しいく}→飼育：06422_shiiku⟧ — raising, breeding (keeping and caring for animals, not necessarily free-range)
- {遊牧|ゆうぼく} — nomadic herding (moving with livestock across regions)
